name: pinned-tool-probe-01
selection: Use the existing one-case pilot selection without substitution. The previous AI answer is already visible; this is an exploratory source/scope probe, not a blind or held-out study. No scanner findings were inspected before this protocol was recorded.
canonical_tree_source: Read from the pinned public GitHub commit API before scanner predictions; offline replay anchors every reconstructed directory object to this identity, not a ref alias or mutable branch.
transport_amendment: Before any scanner run, complete archive transfers exceeded the initial 180-second transport limit. Increase only the bounded transfer time to 600 seconds; preserve tool-probe-protocol.transport-initial.json and failure records. Repository selection, pinned revision, corpus/packet, source-byte/member limits, scanner rules, and reference labels remain unchanged. This is a disclosed exploratory workflow repair, not an externally preregistered study.
source_verification: Verify pinned commit/tree correspondence, complete retained Git tree membership, every archive blob identity and size, and all supplied instruction/context bytes. Create real files and safe internal symlinks, not placeholder paths. Refuse unsupported entries, external/unresolved links, missing tracked entries, tampering, or exceeded limits; retain failures as failures.
tree_identity_clarification: Before any scanner run, the initial attempted collection stopped: the retained recursive-tree response SHA equaled the queried commit ref, not commit.tree.sha. Preserve that original response unchanged; obtain the canonical tree SHA from the pinned commit and reconstruct every directory Git object to verify the entire retained tree. Do not equate an API ref/alias SHA with a canonical Git tree object.
offline_replay: A local archive may be supplied explicitly to avoid repeat downloads after transport failures. It must satisfy the same resource, complete tree, Git object, and supplied-byte checks. Transport provenance is not authenticated by offline replay; it does not permit replacement cases, files, or artificial paths.
safety: Download public source data only. Never run downloaded commands, hooks, dependencies, tests, or models. Do not contact maintainers or print source text, credential values, or server errors. Require new output paths; never remove existing user data. Archives/snapshots remain local and ignored, not committed.
scopes: Retain default native discovery and a separately named root-instruction run. Only research-process discovery is restricted for the latter; scanner rules and filesystem path checks remain unchanged. Referenced documents are present but not semantically analyzed unless native discovery selects them.
reporting: These are actual unscored lint observations, not verified bugs or reference labels. Native instruction scope and complete path index can exceed the bounded AI packet. comparison_ready stays false; correctness metrics stay null. No AI/hybrid scoring, human annotation, scanner tuning, or product-value claim is authorized by this probe.
contamination_boundary: Retain all original unresolved cases and artifacts. Observers of either output are not blind annotators of this case. If any result informs rule/prompt changes, declare development reuse and use new independent inputs for a later holdout.
